args.title: Ironbark Tooling: Cold-chain logistics in 2026 (newsletter + article + companion)
args.body:
Combined three-bullet summary of Ironbark Tooling's latest newsletter ("Cold-chain logistics in 2026"), the article it links to, and the article's companion piece:

- Temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data.
- Most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads, not from less spoilage.
- The companion piece reports that pilots cut claims by a quarter.

Sources:
- Newsletter: newsletter@ironbark.example — "Cold-chain logistics in 2026"
- Article: https://blog.ironbark.example/2026/cold-chain
- Companion: https://insights.ironbark.example/cold-chain/companion
